meta.what: Canonical Bangladesh area list: BBS base, reconciled one to one with the national portal list. Used by tools and tests, not loaded by phones.

bbs_source.dataset: Bangladesh - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB), version v03
bbs_source.publisher: OCHA Field Information Services Section (FISS); contributed by OCHA ROAP
bbs_source.licence: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
bbs_source.attribution: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS), via OCHA HDX (CC BY-IGO)
bbs_source.modification_notice: Adapted by SafeConnect: the official tables were extracted into JSON with names, codes, parents and coordinates unchanged; the links between the 2020 and 2023 codes and to the national portal list were derived by tools/build_master_areas.py and are marked as derived. BBS, OCHA and HDX do not endorse SafeConnect or this adaptation.

code_rules: division BDnn; district BDnnnn (division + BBS district code); upazila-level unit: 10-digit 2023 code
union code: 10-digit code of the 2020 point table (old 8-digit parent + 2 digits), official; legacy_upazila_code is its official old parent code

DERIVED (not official): upazilas[].legacy (old 8-digit code, name and the grade of the name match) and unions[].derived_upazila (the 2023 parent, null when unresolved); the old to new link is the rule new = old[:6] + '00' + old[6:], see tools/build_master_areas.py
usage_rules: A position matched to a union point is the NEAREST UNION CENTRE, never an exact union: the current HDX dataset (v03) has no union polygons.

A 2020 BBS / OCHA ROAP union polygon set (5,160 units) exists only as a third-party copy (geoBoundaries; 12.5 MB simplified, 341 MB full; HDX origin page returns 404; licence statements conflict). It is not used.
meta.portal_link_rule: linked only when code, name and parent all agree; one to one; never by name alone
